answer: Stake-weighted peer attestation stops Sybils by making each new identity need vouches from established agents who lock a bond per endorsement. Like a pulse check that only a living network can pass, an endorser risks their own stake and reputation on every vouch, and an atlas of trust links maps who vouched for whom, so a fake cluster is visible at a glance. An attacker cannot wander in with thousands of sock puppets: each fake needs a separate honest-looking endorser willing to risk a bond, so the cost scales with every identity while honest newcomers pay nothing beyond one real introduction.
